promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-03 (nyiso-119). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-03-nyiso-119-seny-increment (bundle results/calibration/nyiso119_seny_increment). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, C3c the sole ledgered caveat, UNCHANGED. WHAT THIS PROMOTION DOES: it arms nyiso_seny_rcpf_increment_step, THE NAMED OPEN SUCCESSOR nyiso-118 deliberately did NOT fold in (rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]). It is a PUBLISHED-TIER OMISSION FIX, not a lever. The NYISO SOM states the SENY 30-minute product as a $500/MW base over 'at least 1,300 MW for all hours' PLUS an additional condition-varying increment binding a subset of hours at $40/MW, and the 2023 SOM p. A-132 prints the pair as ONE OBJECT -- 'SENY $500+$40' -- as the as-enforced 2022-2023 curves. That transcription ALREADY EXISTED in the codebase, in the NYISO_RCPF_EAST_FAMILIES provenance block, before this session. nyiso_dynamic_reserve_requirements has ALWAYS ENFORCED that increment (the measured #1344 series runs 1,550/1,800 MW against the 1,300 MW base for most of the day) and NOTHING EVER PRICED IT: the whole shortfall was charged against the base curve, whose very first rung ($500/8 = $62.50) already sat above the ENTIRE measured $23.92/$30.37/$40.00 SENY envelope. That is exactly why nyiso-118 was a PARTIAL. ONE config delta, ZERO free parameters: the DOF ledger goes 32 -> 33 entries with n_residual UNCHANGED at 6. NO NEW NUMBER (rule 5) -- it clears the same bar the NYC step curve cleared: the $40 is the SAME Ancillary Services Manual section 6.8 item 12 already pinned for east_30min_total, whose clause names SOUTHEASTERN EXPLICITLY ('Eastern, Southeastern, New York City, or Long Island 30-Minute Reserves ... shall be $40/MW') on the same July-2021 vintage spanning all of 2023-2025; the 1,300 MW breakpoint is READ from NYISO_RCPF_LOCATIONAL rather than re-typed; and the hourly requirement was already on the balance row. THE BASE TIER KEEPS ITS RAMP, DELIBERATELY: the posted-price instrument identifies the INCREMENT tier (an atom at exactly $40.00, 52 hours of 2025, zero hours above in any year) and says NOTHING about the base ($500 never reached in 26,301 hours), so per nyiso-115's own discipline an UNIDENTIFIED shape is left alone. RULE 19 IS RECONCILED BY SUBSTITUTION, NEVER STACKING: the two-tier construction carries the hourly requirement NATIVELY in the increment band -- which is what the requirement above the base physically IS -- so SENY takes this branch INSTEAD of the nyiso_ordc_measured_step_span branch, exactly as li_30min_total's family-scoped ladder already opts itself out of the global flag; span-scaling on top would double-count and break the identity nyiso-118 restored. ALL EIGHT PRE-REGISTERED GATES PASS AND K-A..K-G ARE ALL SILENT. G1 the tier is LIVE: SENY steps 8->9 / 8->9 / 8->9, first rung $62.50->$40.00 / $62.50->$40.00 / $62.50->$40.00, base-ramp penalties BYTE-IDENTICAL to control in every year, increment width == max(0, requirement[t]-1300) and base total == min(1300, requirement[t]) EXACTLY in every hour; the increment band is positive in 6061 / 6027 / 6115 hours. G2 the nyiso-118 identity SURVIVES: total step width == requirement_mw at 0 / 0 / 0 violating hours in the treatment, including the zero-requirement Thunderstorm-Alert hours where both bands clip to zero width. G3a THE SCOPE KILL, on CONSTRUCTION: all EIGHT non-SENY families byte-identical between arms in widths, requirement AND penalties, reachable price delta $0.000, all three years -- so the rule-23 freezes on the NYC $25/MW curve and the LI ladder are NOT disturbed (K-A, K-B silent). G3c an instrument that never touches the parquet: solve-log ORDC steps 59 -> 60, EXACTLY +1 in exactly one family, in every pass and every year, committed as each bundle's ordc_steps.log. G4 the tier PRICES: 2 / 0 / 4 hours of 2023/24/25 have a shortfall STRICTLY inside the band and 2 / 0 / 4 of them price at EXACTLY the published $40.00 -- every one. G5/G6 pass with zero slack and zero dump in BOTH arms. THE COUPLING AND SCOPE QUESTIONS WERE DISCHARGED EX ANTE, ON CONSTRUCTION, BEFORE THE SOLVE (scripts/probes/_nyiso119_seny_increment_construction_probe.py -> results/calibration/nyiso119_seny_increment_construction_probe.json): the probe builds the NYISO ReserveDesign TWICE at one HEAD and diffs every family's requirement, ordc_penalties and ordc_step_widths with NO LP and NO dual, because dual and held_mw are SOLVED co-optimization outputs whose byte-identity can only pass when the mechanism does nothing (the nyiso-115 G2 error, and nyiso-118's live demonstration that a provably-unchanged curve still moves its dual through general equilibrium). G4 AS PRE-REGISTERED FAILED AND THAT IS RECORDED, NOT QUIETLY REDEFINED: it demanded an exact $40.00 for every hour with shortfall in the CLOSED interval (0, band], which is ASYMMETRIC -- it excluded the LOWER kink (s > 0) while INCLUDING the upper one (s == band). At either kink the LP is degenerate and the dual is legitimately anywhere between the adjacent bands' prices; that is exactly why the zero-shortfall hours price at $7.75/$17.31 rather than $0, which the pre-registered form ALREADY tolerated. Re-specified onto what K-G actually asks -- the STRICT interior must price at the published increment, and the band edge must be BRACKETED by the adjacent band prices ($57.28 inside [$40.00, $62.50]). The MECHANISM is unchanged; only the GATE's boundary handling is. STRUCTURAL CORROBORATION FROM THE SOLVE ITSELF: in the treatment's deepest 2025 hour the LP stops holding SENY reserve at EXACTLY held_mw = 1300.0 -- THE PUBLISHED BASE -- because past that point the $40 tier no longer justifies holding more; in the control it stopped at 1575.0, which is 1800 minus one control band width and has no market meaning. The published demand curve's own breakpoint is now where the dispatch stops. MEASURED EFFECT: SENY max dual 62.50->40.00 / -0.00->-0.00 / 87.07->62.50 with binding hours 2->2 / 0->0 / 8->8. S-OVER IS NARROWED, REPORTED NOT GATED (rule 1 [R-STRUCT]): of 10 binding hours, those above the year's MEASURED ceiling go 8 -> 4 and those above the PUBLISHED $40 increment go 8 -> 2. IT IS NOT CLOSED AND IS NOT REPORTED AS CLOSED: 2023/2024's REALIZED ceilings ($23.92/$30.37) sit BELOW the published $40 cap -- the market never drove those years to full band saturation -- so pricing at the published cap is still above them. That residual is an INCIDENCE/DEPTH question, not a curve-construction one. ALL 18 SCORED NUMERIC FIELDS ARE EQUAL to this run's own same-HEAD zero-delta control (2026-08-03-nyiso-119-control-zerodelta), every criterion verdict is identical, and the grade summary (9 scored / 8 target / 1 ledgered / 0 fails) and C1 headline (all 14/14, free 10/10) are unchanged. THE ISO-SCOPE NULL WAS PRE-REGISTERED (prereg section 6): SENY binds in almost no hours and a demand curve can only price where there is a shortfall, so a CORRECT mechanism may move almost nothing at ISO scope. PROMOTION RESTS ON RULE 1 [R-STRUCT] / RULE 14 [R-ACCURATE], NOT ON GATE MOVEMENT: a published tier of a published demand curve belongs in the model because it is REAL. C3c UNCHANGED -- also a pre-registered null; this does NOT reach nyiso-110's everyday-reserve-formation gap and is NOT reported as closing it. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso119-seny-increment-2026-08-03.md, PREREG-nyiso119-seny-increment-2026-08-03.md, nyiso119_gate_scores.json, nyiso119_seny_increment_construction_probe.json.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
